**Introduction to Balaji Amines Limited**

Balaji Amines Limited (BAL) is a leading Indian chemical manufacturing company headquartered in **Solapur, Maharashtra**, at **165-A Railway Lines, Solapur – 413001**. Established in **1988**, the company has grown into a prominent player in the specialty chemicals sector, catering to diverse industries such as **pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, animal nutrition, water treatment, and personal care**. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and sustainability, BAL has earned a reputation as a reliable supplier of high-purity amines, derivatives, and specialty chemicals, both in domestic and international markets.

The company’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are equipped with advanced technology, ensuring adherence to global quality standards such as **ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001**. BAL’s product portfolio includes **ethylamines, propylamines, isopropylamines, morpholine derivatives, and other specialty chemicals**, which serve as key intermediates in various industrial applications. The company’s commitment to **research and development (R&D)** has enabled it to develop customized solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of its clients.

Balaji Amines Limited operates with a customer-centric approach, emphasizing **timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and technical support**. The company has a strong distribution network, supplying products to over **50 countries** across **Europe, North America, Asia, and Latin America**. With a dedicated workforce and a vision for sustainable growth, BAL continues to expand its capabilities while maintaining ethical business practices and environmental responsibility.

As a publicly listed entity on the **Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and National Stock Exchange (NSE)**, Balaji Amines Limited remains a trusted name in the chemical industry, driving innovation and contributing to India’s position as a global chemical manufacturing hub.
